Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — we have a new Eng Manager (Leah) starting Mon 9:00 AM PT. I put together a concise 'first-week + 30/60/90' checklist for managers. Can folks claim owners for items and suggest any gaps? Want Leah's first ~100 hours to be friction-free.

Jordan (Eng): Happy to own team intros + tech deep-dive. Also recommend we set a concrete 'first-week deliverable' so Leah has an early win.

Priya (People Ops): Agreed. Draft checklist below — please comment with owners. Will also drop calendar templates.

Priya (People Ops): ```
1) Pre-day (complete by EOD Fri)
   - Laptop imaged, corp Slack + SSO, GitHub org access, Miro, Notion, PagerDuty.
   - Create calendar blocks: 1:1 recurring, focus time, onboarding ops.
   - Expense + payroll forms submitted.

2) Day 1 (9:00-17:00)
   - 9:00 AM: People Ops welcome (15-20m)
   - 9:30 AM: Corp security + KMS intro
   - 10:00 AM: Team all-hands intro (15m)
   - 11:00 AM: 1:1 w/manager (expectations & OKRs)
   - Lunch: informal team lunch (virtual/in-person)
   - 3:00 PM: Access + environment tour (devstack, infra creds)

3) Week 1 goals
   - Shadow oncall / runbook walkthrough
   - Review roadmap + active rollouts
   - Define 30/60/90 draft and agree on 1 quick-win (owner + scope)
   - Schedule cross-functional intros (SRE, Product, Sales, Legal)

4) 30/60/90 outline
   - 30d: onboard key systems, shipped observation, 1 stakeholder deliverable
   - 60d: lead a planning sync, own a small project start-to-finish
   - 90d: measurable impact metric + onboarding of direct reports

5) Who-to-ask (quick contacts)
   - Access / device / VPN -> @Ana (IT)
   - Recruiting / org chart -> @Sam (Recruiting)
   - Infra & runtime cred questions -> @Jordan (Eng)
   - Payroll / benefits -> People Ops (me)
```

Sam (Recruiting): I can own the org-chart intro + hiring docs; will also send Leah the hiring pipeline summary + open roles.

Ana (IT): I will take device build + VPN. Can we add a 'VPN test' step in Pre-day? Also note: HSM / KMS admin requests need manager approval and takes ~3 business days.

Jordan (Eng): Adding: Week1 add 'live canary runbook review' and 'read 2 recent incident postmortems'. Also recommend 'budget/headcount forecast' be on Week2.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll add VPN test and the runbook items. Sam — can you attach the interview notes template to the onboarding packet?

Sam (Recruiting): Yep — I'll drop the template + sample candidate notes.

onboard-bot: new-hire-checklist created (ID: 4821) — Reminder: assign owner commitments by Fri.

Priya (People Ops): Final ask: can each owner reply with a 1-line commitment (what you'll do and ETA) by EOD Fri? I’ll collate into the Notion onboarding doc: https://notion.redwood.dev/onboarding/manager-first-week (temp link). :thumbsup: 

Jordan (Eng): Owner commitment: I’ll run team intros + technical deep-dive, prepare runbook list, and add postmortems by Friday EOD.

Ana (IT): Owner commitment: Device imaged + VPN test steps added to playbook, will complete access by Fri 3pm PT.

Sam (Recruiting): Owner commitment: Org chart + hiring pipeline doc posted, interview notes template attached by Thu noon.

Priya (People Ops): Perfect — I’ll send calendar templates and the kickoff invite once owners are in Notion. Thanks everyone!
